title: Uber/Lyft Accident in Albuquerque
metaDescription: Uber/Lyft accident in Albuquerque: rideshare insurance layers, NM reporting, and when to consult an attorney.
excerpt: Educational Albuquerque, NM guide — 3-year SOL, local hospitals, and insurer tactics. Not legal advice.

sections.heading: First 10 minutes: safety and 911
paragraphs: A collision on I-95 or surface streets in Albuquerque can escalate quickly. If vehicles are drivable and it is safe, move to a shoulder or parking lot. Turn on hazard lights.
Call 911 when anyone reports pain, airbags deploy, fluids leak, or traffic is blocked. Albuquerque County dispatch will route Albuquerque police or state patrol depending on location.
list: Stay inside the vehicle with seatbelts on if traffic passes closely at highway speed
Do not admit fault — describe facts only
Request a crash report number before officers leave

sections.heading: Albuquerque documentation checklist
paragraphs: Photograph all vehicles, license plates, VIN stickers, skid marks, traffic signals, and visible injuries. Albuquerque insurers expect timestamped photos.
Collect names and phone numbers from witnesses — independent accounts matter on I-95, I-75, US-1 and in Albuquerque County.
Exchange insurance policy numbers and registration; note employer if the other driver was working.

sections.heading: Medical care within 24 hours
paragraphs: Albuquerque has Albuquerque Regional Medical Center and Albuquerque General Hospital among its major facilities. Level I trauma care is available at Albuquerque Level I Trauma Center.
Whiplash, concussion, and internal injuries may appear hours later. A same-day urgent care or ER visit creates a medical record insurers cannot easily dismiss.

sections.heading: New Mexico reporting rules
paragraphs: New Mexico requires crash reporting when injuries, death, or significant property damage occur. Minimum liability limits are 25/50/10.
Cooperate with officers; request a copy of the report through the investigating agency. If police do not respond, check https://www.dot.nm.gov/ for self-report thresholds.

sections.heading: Insurance notification without hurting your claim
paragraphs: Notify your carrier with basic facts — date, location, vehicles involved. Decline recorded statements until you understand your coverage and injuries.
New Mexico uses Pure comparative comparative negligence; anything you say can affect fault allocation.

sections.heading: Evidence preservation in Albuquerque
paragraphs: Dashcam, Ring doorbell, and business security footage near Albuquerque downtown interchange is often deleted within 7–30 days. Send written preservation letters when appropriate.
Save repair estimates, rental receipts, and mileage to medical appointments.

sections.heading: When to explore attorney matching
paragraphs: Consider a free consultation if you were hospitalized, fault is disputed, a commercial vehicle was involved, or the adjuster offers a quick settlement before treatment finishes.
